data.body: Milestone: completed tfstate live-state scrub and historical version purge for non-generated SecureString values. Backed up the clean current state object first, then removed the two data-source instances that were persisting decrypted values (names only: /rebar/prod/alert-endpoint, /auth-solutions/GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET). Verified current state has zero non-generated SecureString fields with non-empty value/value_wo and that the main tfstate key now has one remaining version with zero affected non-generated SecureString names. Rotated internally generated/self-contained secret: /rebar/prod/mcp-hmac-signing-key. Re-materialized secrets on-box and recreated review-bot/opcert/mcp with autodeploy paused; verified review-bot, opcert, and live MCP health. Flagged for user/operator rotation, not rotated by me: /rebar/prod/anthropic-api-key, /rebar/prod/jira-api-token, GitHub PAT/deploy/OAuth secrets, Gerrit admin/bot credentials, SSH host/private keys, opcert/rebar-bot signing keys, and auth cookie/Google OAuth secrets because they require external trust/third-party issuance or coordinated deploys outside the self-regenerable boundary.
